title: RejectionReason
description: A stable, machine-readable rejection reason produced by the enforcement layer. Mirrors RejectionReason in crates/hook-core/src/reason.rs: the numeric code is the on-chain ContractError code (2-10, non-dense) and the name is the stable snake_case identifier consumed by tooling and the safeguard-audit polyrepo. Never rename a variant. Every listed reason is produced by a real gate (see docs/errors.md for the completeness audit); removed codes are never reissued.

code.description: ContractError / RejectionReason code. 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 are the rejection reasons; the contract adds its own codes outside that set (12 already_initialized).

description.description: Human-readable meaning; never parsed by tooling.
